verdict.rationale: Luma documents its own agentic features. Luma Agents run multi-step video and image workflows, agents "research, generate, and refine" across media, and Luma Skills promise to "Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever." This is only a headline claim of reusable, agent-run workflows, with no detail on how they execute. Nothing shows background execution, triggers, or a recurring schedule, so a reusable workflow cannot stand in for a scheduled automation. Missing for 10: documented background or unattended execution, scheduling or event triggers, details on how Skills run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
